why: Shell cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/shell-1.md, P1 shell-1.5): `SplitPage`'s doc and JSDoc pass `selected={store.field.section.isSet}` (`src/page/parts/split-page.tsx:22,31`), and a field handle has no `isSet` (tsc TS2339). `!isDefault` is the nearest, and a section field writes no param for its fallback, so on a 390 px phone the fallback section (General) cannot be opened: the tap changes nothing and the list stays (`.evidence/cycle-shell-1/actions.log` B5). The build's `SettingsPage.tsx:91` carries the workaround.
what: A `SplitPage` on a phone opens every pane, the fallback's included.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/router/controls/define.ts and the field codecs it uses (an `isSet` on the handle; how a written fallback is kept)
their tests and one layout test
change: Pick one and say which in the PR: (a) a field handle exposes `isSet` (its param is present), and a push field written with its fallback keeps the param, so choosing General writes `?section=general`; or (b) `SplitPage` takes the pane field itself (`pane={store.field.section}`) and reads whether it was chosen. acceptance: At 390 px, choosing the fallback section opens its pane, and Back returns to the list (layout test)
